executionAuthorization: User September7: refine selected mechanisms, then HL/SR context, then actual ladder; R01 first bounded checkpoint.
selection: C01-20 and C02-27/32 have positive increments in both windows/delays but unmet budgets. Test mechanism strength and context clock, not alpha entry/exit retuning. MFI calendar already refined in T02; preserved frozen for later context review. Sparse C01-30 OBV case parked, not rejected.

predicates.vwap: completed context close distance percent from its own fully observed UTC-day actual-turnover VWAP > threshold
predicates.shock: abs(context close - preceding close) / preceding ATR14 <= threshold; numerator absolute, no direction filter
predicates.cmf: CMF20 signed close-location volume flow < threshold, short-only anchors

timing: Source expected end=floor(signal/contextTf)*contextTf, no stale fallback; source availableAt<=signal. Preceding ATR must be immediately adjacent closed bar. Closed source day preserved at midnight. Failed trigger discarded; delayed entry freezes evidence; timeout from actual entry plus independent exit delay.
comparators: Unfiltered parent, archived original pair, same-side clock and own context-readiness-only parent. Report delta vs BOTH unfiltered and original pair, never count existing pair gain as refinement benefit.
screens: Unchanged C01/T02 n>=30full/10recent each delay, positive net/stress, solvent, every marked month delta vs unfiltered and readiness >=-320. Profit >=+500full/+200recent each delay, DD no worse. Defense >=90% positive-parent retention, fewer losing dollars, fullDD>=20% and1pp improvement, recent no worse, beat exposure-scaled readiness parent. Strict clock separate. Refined settings also compared with original pair; never lower old bars after result.
reporting: Baseline-first W/L winning/losing dollars/open/net/DD/stress; all9 plus3 original pairs; per-month original/readiness deltas; newly enabled vs removed trade accounting and concentration; independent math/schedule/accounting verifier.
nextStageBoundary: Complete R01 evidence checkpoint first. HL/SR definitions must be separately frozen on healthy overlap with indicator-only/readiness controls, then ladder transfer one decision at a time. No automatic promotion of failed candidates. No live changes, commit or push.
limitations: Same previously mined overlapping windows, zero publication-lag historical model with delayed fills sensitivity, before funding, fixed notional no portfolio/ladder. Three context families, nine one-axis changes only; no extra threshold grid or sequencing.
